events.name: Learning Hub — Session 7
events.description:
Topic for parents is: 
Culture & Identity in Supporting Belonging & Participation.
Importance of first language in supporting good learning outcome and wellbeing.
Valuing Students’ Cultural Backgrounds.
Importance of Home-School Connections.

Topic for Youth/Kids is:
Building confidence via sports.
Introduction to traditional games and guiding thought behind those. 
Qualities enhanced via sports.
Physical education and its benefits in today's world.
